name: tessera-poll-worker
description: Audience poll service for tessera decks on Cloudflare Workers Free: join page, answers and images in Durable Objects, live change signals over WebSockets, a game layer (/api/game), AI routes via OpenRouter.

scripts.deploy: node scripts/sync.mjs && node test/e2e.test.mjs && node test/game.e2e.test.mjs && wrangler deploy
scripts.test: node scripts/sync.mjs && node test/draw.test.mjs && node test/help.test.mjs && node test/ai.test.mjs && node test/remix.test.mjs && node test/legacy.test.mjs && node test/e2e.test.mjs && node test/game.e2e.test.mjs && python test/live_browser.py
